title: Your Career Profile
subtitle: Add your career history and skills once. We'll automatically adapt it for every job you apply to.

actions.clearProfileTip: Clear all profile fields and start from a blank slate
actions.exportBackupTip: Download your career profile as Markdown (.md)

dialog.confirmReplaceDesc: Importing this file will replace your current profile data. Are you sure you want to proceed?
dialog.confirmClearDesc: Are you sure you want to clear all profile data? This action cannot be undone.
dialog.confirmLoadSampleDesc: Loading this sample profile will replace your current profile data. Are you sure you want to proceed?

choice.title: How would you like to start your profile?
choice.subtitle: Choose the input method that best matches your workflow. Everything is processed 100% locally and privately.
choice.importCardDesc: Upload your existing CV in PDF, TXT, or Markdown. Content is extracted locally.
choice.freeTextCardDesc: Paste unformatted career notes, LinkedIn summary, or import an existing PDF/TXT. No formatting required—the AI structures everything automatically.
choice.freeTextCardDescExisting: View or edit your current career profile as plain text notes.
choice.dropOrBrowse: Drag & drop PDF, TXT or MD here, or click to browse
choice.guidedCardDesc: Build your profile section by section with dedicated inputs for personal info, work experience, categorized skills, and education from scratch.
choice.guidedCardDescExisting: Continue editing your structured profile sections: experience, education, and skills.
choice.syncCardDesc: Already have your CV on your computer? Transfer your Master CV, versions, and vacancies instantly via encrypted QR or pairing code.
choice.syncCardShortDesc: Transfer your CV with a QR code
choice.importCardShortDesc: Upload your PDF, TXT or Markdown
choice.guidedCardShortDesc: Start from scratch, step by step

modes.freeTextHint: Paste raw text, LinkedIn summary, or unformatted notes. No Markdown syntax required—the AI synthesizes and structures everything automatically.
modes.freeTextInGuidedNotice: You have raw career notes saved. The AI will structure them into this form automatically during tailoring in Step 2, or you can fill this form directly.

completeness.title: Master Profile Completeness
completeness.levelComplete: Robust profile! Ready to tailor with high ATS conversion.
completeness.levelGood: Solid profile. You can start tailoring or add sections for greater affinity.
completeness.levelInitial: Basic profile. We recommend adding more career details for best results.

hints.fullName: This will appear as the main name heading on your resume.

hints.linkedin: Optional. Recommended so evaluators can review your network and recommendations.
hints.portfolio: Optional. Great for demonstrating live demos, GitHub repositories, or design work.
